original.name: FriendlyOperation.exists_fixed_point
original.statement: β → Option (α × γ × β)) (op : γ → Seq α → Seq α) [h : FriendlyOperationClass op] : ∃ f : β → Seq α, ∀ b : β, match F b with | none => f b = nil | some (a, c, b') => f b = Seq.cons a (op c (f b'))
